# Cleanup
```{r pike muscle data cleanup, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

#read in pike data from source
Pike1 <- read.delim("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Pike_Latest_Version.txt", 
                    sep = ";", dec = ".", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

Pike2 <- Pike1%>%
  transmute(ID=case_when(Fish_ID=="BH-91050.2"~"BH-91050",
                         Fish_ID=="BH-51614"&Waterbody=="BAT"~"NA",
                         Fish_ID=="BH-90307"&MarkorRecap=="Mark"~"NA",
                         TRUE~Fish_ID),
            capt_date=Date,
            TL_mm = Total_Length_mm,
            weight=Weight,
            sex=Sex,
            area=Waterbody,
            Long=case_when(is.na(Capture_Longitude)==T~Release_Longitude,
                           TRUE~Capture_Longitude),
            Lat=case_when(is.na(Capture_Latitude)==T~Release_Latitude,
                          TRUE~Capture_Latitude))

#Read pike SI data
pike_NCS1 <- read.csv2("Data/Pike/2022-09-08_NCS_Pike.CSV", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

pike_NCS2 <- pike_NCS1%>%
  transmute(ID=substr(Identifier.1, 1,8),
            ID2=substr(Identifier.1,9,10),
            Sample="Muscle",
            d15N=as.numeric(d.15N.14N.Calculated),
            d13C=as.numeric(d.13C.12C.Calculated),
            d34S=as.numeric(d.34S.32S.Calculated),
            CN_ratio=as.numeric(C..)/as.numeric(N..),
            comment=paste(Comment.1,"|",Comment.2))%>%
  filter(!grepl("Measurement repeated", comment)|ID=="BH-00380"|ID=="BH-00829")

Mixed <- read.delim("Data/Pike/2021-02 Boddenhecht Timo Rittweg TG.txt")

Mixed2 <- Mixed%>%
  transmute(ID=ID2,
            ID2=NA,
            Sample=ID1,
            d15N=as.numeric(d15N..permil.N2.atm.),
            d13C=as.numeric(d13C..permil.VPDB.),
            d34S=as.numeric(d34S..permil.CDT.),
            CN_ratio=as.numeric(weight.C)/as.numeric(weight.N),
            comment=NA)%>%
  filter(Sample!="Eyelens")

pike_NCS2 <- rbind(pike_NCS2, Mixed2)

pike_NCS3 <- fread("Data/Pike/2023-04-21_NCS_Pike.CSV")

pike_NCS4 <- pike_NCS3%>%
  transmute(ID=Identifier.1,
            ID2=NA,
            Sample=Identifier.2,
            d15N=as.numeric(d15N),
            d13C=as.numeric(d13C),
            d34S=as.numeric(d34S),
            CN_ratio=(Amount.ug*(Cperc/100))/(Amount.ug*(Nperc/100)),
            comment=Comment)%>%
  filter(Sample!="eye lens")

pike_NCSall <- rbind(pike_NCS2, pike_NCS4)

#Join pike data
length(unique(pike_NCSall$ID))

Pikedata <- Pike2%>%
  inner_join(pike_NCSall,by="ID")

length(unique(Pikedata$ID))

#check missing fish
pikeSIall <- data.frame(ID = unique(pike_NCSall$ID))
pikeSIDall <- data.frame(ID = unique(Pikedata$ID), Sample = "TRUE")

Pikecheck <- pikeSIall%>%
  left_join(pikeSIDall, by = "ID")


#average SI values
pikedata2 <- Pikedata%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(ID=ID,
            ID2=ID2,
            capt_date=capt_date,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
            weight_g=weight,
            sex=sex,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            Sample_type=Sample,
            d15N=mean(d15N, na.rm = T),
            d13C=mean(d13C, na.rm = T),
            d34S=mean(d34S, na.rm = T),
            CN_ratio=mean(CN_ratio, na.rm = T),
            comment=comment)%>%
  distinct()

#Join ecotype pike with SI data
Otopike <- read.delim("Data/Pike/Pikedata_ecotypes.txt", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = "\t", dec = ".")

Otopike.SI <- Otopike%>%left_join(pikedata2, by="ID")%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            ID2=ID2,
            capt_date=capt_date,
            TL_mm=TL_mm.x,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            sex=sex.x,
            study_area=waterbody,
            waterbody=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            lifeyear=lifeyear,
            inc_um=inc_um,
            res_mean=res_mean,
            Sr_mean=Sr_mean,
            SI_sample=Sample_type,
            ecotype=ecotype,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            comment=comment)

length(unique(Otopike.SI[is.na(Otopike.SI$d13C)==F,]$ID))
length(unique(Otopike.SI$ID))

fwrite(pikedata2, "Data/Pike/Pike_SI_all_clean_average.csv")
fwrite(Otopike.SI, "Data/Pike/Otopike_SI_clean_average.csv")
```

```{r pike eye lens data cleanup, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

#read in pike data from source
Pike1 <- read.delim("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Pike_Latest_Version.txt", 
                    sep = ";", dec = ".", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

Pike2 <- Pike1%>%
  transmute(ID=case_when(Fish_ID=="BH-91050.2"~"BH-91050",
                         Fish_ID=="BH-51614"&Waterbody=="BAT"~"NA",
                         Fish_ID=="BH-90307"&MarkorRecap=="Mark"~"NA",
                         TRUE~Fish_ID),
            capt_date=Date,
            TL_mm = Total_Length_mm,
            weight=Weight,
            sex=Sex,
            area=Waterbody,
            Long=case_when(is.na(Capture_Longitude)==T~Release_Longitude,
                           TRUE~Capture_Longitude),
            Lat=case_when(is.na(Capture_Latitude)==T~Release_Latitude,
                          TRUE~Capture_Latitude))

#Read pike SI data

Mixed <- fread("Data/Mixed/2021-02 Boddenhecht Timo Rittweg TG.csv")

Pike_NCS1 <- Mixed%>%
  transmute(ID=ID2,
            ID2=NA,
            Sample=ID1,
            Layer=as.numeric(`Lens layer`),
            Diameter=as.numeric(`Eye lens diameter (mm)`),
            amount=NA,
            d15N=as.numeric(`d15N (permil N2 atm)`),
            d13C=as.numeric(`d13C (permil VPDB)`),
            d34S=as.numeric(`d34S (permil CDT)`),
            CN_ratio=as.numeric(`weight%C`)/as.numeric(`weight%N`),
            comment=NA)%>%
  filter(Sample=="Eyelens")

pike_NCS2 <- fread("Data/Pike/2023-04-21_NCS_Pike.CSV")

pike_NCS3 <- pike_NCS2%>%
  transmute(ID=Identifier.1,
            ID2=NA,
            Sample=Identifier.2,
            Layer=as.numeric(Lens.layer),
            Diameter=NA,
            amount=Amount.ug,
            d15N=as.numeric(d15N),
            d13C=as.numeric(d13C),
            d34S=as.numeric(d34S),
            CN_ratio=(Amount.ug*(Cperc/100))/(Amount.ug*(Nperc/100)),
            comment=Comment)%>%
  filter(Sample=="eye lens")

Pike_NCS_eyelens_all <- rbind(Pike_NCS1, pike_NCS3)

Pike_NCS_eyelens_mean <- Pike_NCS_eyelens_all%>%
  group_by(ID, Layer)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(ID=ID,
            ID2=ID2,
            Sample=Sample,
            Layer=Layer,
            Diameter=Diameter,
            amount=mean(amount),
            d15N=mean(d15N, na.rm = T),
            d13C=mean(d13C, na.rm = T),
            d34S=mean(d34S, na.rm = T),
            CN_ratio=mean(CN_ratio, na.rm = T),
            comment=comment)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct()

fwrite(Pike_NCS_eyelens_mean, "Data/pike/Eye-lens-all_clean.csv")
```

```{r Day 1 tricks Prey, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
Prey <- fread("Data/Prey/Preyfish_SI_clean_average.csv")

#Calculate mean of N and C for each species
m_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N, d13C, d34S)~Species, data=Prey, FUN=mean)
# Now the standard deviation
sd_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N, d13C, d34S)~Species, data=Prey, FUN=sd)
# Merging df
descriptive<-cbind(m_by_sp, sd_by_sp)
descriptive<-descriptive[-5]
colnames(descriptive)<-c("Sp", "d15N", "d13C", "sdd15N", "sdd13C")
descriptive
## Now lets look at the range and n
range_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N, d13C, d34S)~Species, data=Prey, FUN=range)
range_by_sp
# N (How many observations)
length_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N, d13C, d34S)~Species, data=Prey, FUN=length)
length_by_sp

##### Using tydivers
data_res<-ddply(Prey, c("Species"), summarize, 
                count=length(Species),
                mC=mean(d13C), sdC=sd(d13C),
                mN=mean(d15N), sdN=sd(d15N),
                mS=mean(d34S), sdS=sd(d34S))
data_res
#####----- 4.0 Lets take a look at the data #####
# Carbon
ggplot(data=Prey, aes(x=Species, y=d13C, group=Species, colour=Species))+geom_boxplot()+geom_point(position="jitter")+
  theme_bw()
# Nitrogen
ggplot(data=Prey, aes(x=Species, y=d15N, group=Species, colour=Species))+geom_boxplot()+geom_point(position="jitter")+
  theme_bw()
#Sulphur
ggplot(data=Prey, aes(x=Species, y=d34S, group=Species, colour=Species))+geom_boxplot()+geom_point(position="jitter")+
  theme_bw()

### Lets plot d13C, d15N and CN 
melt_data<-melt(Prey, id.vars=c(1:11, 16,17))

### With this plot we can observe both isotopes in one plot and we can observe the difference between both of them
ggplot(data=melt_data, aes(x=Species, y=value, group=Species, colour=Species))+
  geom_boxplot()+geom_point(position="jitter")+facet_grid(variable~., scales="free_y")+
  theme_bw()
# Fish lipid content seems to be fine so no correction should be applied. However, in the following sections we have the code to perform
# lipid correction using a model approach. The other approach is the chemical extraction which has to be done before analyzing samples for SIA

### Lets explore our fish data in more detail to see if we have a problem with the lipids
### First we subset the fish
ggplot(data=Prey[Prey$Species=="C.harengus"|Prey$Species=="G.aculeatus",], aes(x=CN_ratio, y=d13C))+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+geom_point()+
  facet_grid(Species~., scales="free_y")+
  theme_bw()

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
##### 5.0  Lipid correction for d13C depending on the C:N,  for values >3.5 (as recommended by Skinner et al 2016) #####
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Lipids are depleted in d13C relative to protein (muscle). 
#It can bias our interpretation of their position in the food web or get wrong proportion on mixing models
# For Anchovy
dep = subset(Prey, Species=="G.aculeatus")
dep$rcn=with(dep, CN_ratio)
dep$L<-with(dep,-20.54+7.24*rcn)
 
mean(dep$d13C);sd(dep$d13C)
mean(dep$rcn);sd(dep$rcn)

# Fishes Kiljunen et al.(2006) # Carefull, this correction is not adequate for invertebrates!!!
dep$d13Cc<-with(dep,ifelse(rcn>3.5, d13C+7.018*(0.048+3.9/(1+287/L)),d13C))

dep2 = subset(Prey, Species=="C.harengus")
dep2$rcn=with(dep2, CN_ratio)
dep2$L<-with(dep2,-20.54+7.24*rcn)
 
mean(dep2$d13C);sd(dep2$d13C)
mean(dep2$rcn);sd(dep2$rcn)

# Fishes Kiljunen et al.(2006) # Carefull, this correction is not adequate for invertebrates!!!
dep2$d13Cc<-with(dep2,ifelse(rcn>3.5, d13C+7.018*(0.048+3.9/(1+287/L)),d13C))

depdep <- rbind(dep, dep2)

depdep2 <- depdep%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            Species=Species,
            capt_date=capt_date,
            SL_mm=SL_mm,
            SL_size_class=SL_size_class,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            height_mm=height_mm,
            sample_type=sample_type,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13Cc,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            comment1=comment1,
            comment2=comment2)

C.corrected <- rbind(Prey[Prey$Species!="C.harengus"&Prey$Species!="G.aculeatus",],depdep2)

fwrite(C.corrected, "Data/Prey/Preyfish_SI_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")
```

```{r Day 1 tricks Pike, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
### Lets plot d13C, d15N and CN 
melt_data<-melt(Prey, id.vars=c(1:11, 16,17))

### With this plot we can observe both isotopes in one plot and we can observe the difference between both of them
ggplot(data=melt_data, aes(x=Species, y=value, group=Species, colour=Species))+
  geom_boxplot()+geom_point(position="jitter")+facet_grid(variable~., scales="free_y")+
  theme_bw()
# Fish lipid content seems to be fine so no correction should be applied. However, in the following sections we have the code to perform
# lipid correction using a model approach. The other approach is the chemical extraction which has to be done before analyzing samples for SIA

### Lets explore our fish data in more detail to see if we have a problem with the lipids
### First we subset the fish
ggplot(data=Pike, aes(x=CN_ratio, y=d13C))+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+geom_point()+
  facet_grid(Species~., scales="free_y")+
  theme_bw()

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
##### 5.0  Lipid correction for d13C depending on the C:N,  for values >3.5 (as recommended by Skinner et al 2016) #####
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Lipids are depleted in d13C relative to protein (muscle). 
#It can bias our interpretation of their position in the food web or get wrong proportion on mixing models
# For Anchovy
dep <-  Pike
dep$rcn <- with(dep, CN_ratio)
dep$L <- with(dep,-20.54+7.24*rcn)
 
mean(dep$d13C, na.rm = T);sd(dep$d13C, na.rm = T)
mean(dep$rcn);sd(dep$rcn)

# Fishes Kiljunen et al.(2006) # Carefull, this correction is not adequate for invertebrates!!!
dep$d13Cc<-with(dep,ifelse(rcn>3.5, d13C+7.018*(0.048+3.9/(1+287/L)),d13C))

dep2 <- dep%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            ID2=ID2,
            Species=Species,
            capt_date=capt_date,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
```

```{r exploration eye lenses, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Lensdata <- fread("Data/pike/Eye-lens-all_clean.csv")

pikedata <- fread("Data/pike/Pikedata_ecotypes.txt")

pike2 <- pikedata%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            waterbody=waterbody,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
            clust=clust,
            ecotype=case_when(clust=="FW int saline|const"~"freshwater resident",
                              ecotype=="FW_resident"~"freshwater resident",
                              ecotype=="Anadromous"~"anadromous",
                              ecotype=="BW-resident"~"brackish resident",
                              ecotype=="Trans-habitat"~"cross-habitat",
                              TRUE~ecotype),
            sex=sex)

Lensdata$ID <- as.factor(Lensdata$ID)
Lensdata$Layer <- as.numeric(Lensdata$Layer)

# Function to reverse layers within each ID group
reverse_layers <- function(layer_vector) {
  max_layer <- max(layer_vector)
  return(max_layer - (layer_vector - min(layer_vector)))
}

# Create a new column "Layer_rev" by reversing the "Layer" values within each "ID" group
Lensdata2 <- Lensdata%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(ID=ID,
                   ID2=ID2,
                   Sample=Sample,
                   Layer=Layer,
                   Layer_rev = reverse_layers(Layer),
                   Diameter=Diameter,
                   amount=amount,
                   d15N=d15N,
                   d13C=d13C,
                   d34S=d34S,
                   CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
                   comment=comment)

Pikelens <- pike2%>%
  inner_join(Lensdata2, by = "ID")

#Plot mean lifelong signal

pl_theme <- theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
                  axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
                  legend.position = "none",
                  legend.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
                  plot.title = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"))

d34S <- ggplot(Pikelens, aes(Layer_rev, d34S))+
  geom_point(size=.2, aes(color=ecotype), position = position_dodge(width = 1), alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_smooth(aes(color = ecotype), method = "loess", lwd = 0.7)+
  scale_color_manual(breaks = c("freshwater resident", "brackish resident", "cross-habitat", "anadromous"),
                     values = c("#C5D86D", "#004643", "#F1C40F", "#00BFB2"))+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(y = expression(delta^34~"S"~("\u2030 VPDB")),
       color = "Ecotype:")+
  ggtitle("d34S")+
  pl_theme

d15N <- ggplot(Pikelens, aes(Layer_rev, d15N))+
  geom_point(size=.2, aes(color=ecotype), position = position_dodge(width = 1), alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_smooth(aes(color = ecotype), method = "loess", lwd = 0.7)+
  scale_color_manual(breaks = c("freshwater resident", "brackish resident", "cross-habitat", "anadromous"),
                     values = c("#C5D86D", "#004643", "#F1C40F", "#00BFB2"))+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("d15N")+
  pl_theme

d13C <- ggplot(Pikelens, aes(Layer_rev, d13C))+
  geom_point(size=.2, aes(color=ecotype), position = position_dodge(width = 1), alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_smooth(aes(color = ecotype), method = "loess", lwd = 0.7)+
  scale_color_manual(breaks = c("freshwater resident", "brackish resident", "cross-habitat", "anadromous"),
                     values = c("#C5D86D", "#004643", "#F1C40F", "#00BFB2"))+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("d13C")+
  pl_theme

Eyeplot <- ggarrange(d34S, d15N, d13C, nrow = 1, common.legend = T)

Eyeplot1 <- annotate_figure(Eyeplot, bottom = text_grob("Eye lens layer # (inner to outer)", size = 10, color = "black"))

ggsave("Figures/Eyelens-data-ecotypes.png", Eyeplot1, width = 15, height = 7, units = "cm", bg = "white")
```
